title: General Financial Rules (GFR) 2017
authority: Ministry of Finance, Department of Expenditure, Government of India
summary: Statutory framework governing all public procurement of goods, works, and consulting services by Central Government Ministries, Departments, and attached CPSEs.

clauses.title: Restrictions on Procurement from Land Border Sharing Countries
clauses.legal_text: Any bidder from a country which shares a land border with India will be eligible to bid in any procurement whether of goods, services or works only if the bidder is registered with the Competent Authority (DPIIT Registration Committee). Beneficial ownership compliance is mandatory.

conditions.failure_message: Bidder fails Rule 144(xi) of GFR 2017: Non-compliant land border sharing entity without valid DPIIT registration certificate.

clauses.title: Mandatory Procurement through Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
clauses.legal_text: Procurement of common use Goods and Services available on GeM is mandatory for Ministries/Departments and Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs). All statutory credentials including GSTIN, PAN, and Udyam must be authenticated via API against official databases.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of Rule 149: Bidder PAN is inoperative or invalid in Income Tax e-filing database.

clauses.title: Debarment from Bidding (Blacklisting)
clauses.legal_text: A bidder shall be debarred if he has been convicted of an offence under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 or the Indian Penal Code. Debarment by any Central Ministry/Department or CPSE operates across all Central Government entities for the specified debarment period.

conditions.failure_message: Statutory Disqualification under Rule 151 of GFR 2017: Active debarment order found in Central CPPP / GeM Registry.

clauses.title: Mandatory Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs)
clauses.legal_text: The Central Government may mandate reservations and purchase preference for Micro and Small Enterprises registered under the Udyam portal. Eligible MSEs shall be exempted from payment of earnest money deposit (EMD) and tender fees.

conditions.failure_message: Advisory under Rule 153: Udyam MSME certificate is unverified or expired; MSE purchase preference will not be applied.
